课程简介（中文）

《医学英语术语及应用》是一门面向医学专业本科生的英语高阶板块课程，通过系统学习医学英语词源、构词法、语音规则以及医学术语在各人体系统中的应用，使学生能够准确理解和使用医学英语术语。本课程紧密结合解剖学、生理学、病理学及临床实践，注重医学术语在病例阅读、文献理解及专业沟通中的综合应用能力培养。学生将通过课堂讲授、术语分析及医学英文材料阅读等方式，逐步建立起扎实的医学专业英语术语体系，为后续医学专业课程和科研训练奠定语言基础。

 

课程简介（英文）

Medical English Terminology and Applications is an introductory course designed for undergraduate medical students. The course provides a systematic overview of the origins, structure, and usage of medical terminology in English, covering word roots, prefixes, suffixes, phonetic rules, and the application of terminology across major human body systems. Integrating anatomy, physiology, pathology, and clinical practice, this course emphasizes the understanding and practical use of medical terminology in case reading, and professional communication. Through lectures, terminology analysis, case discussions, and reading authentic medical materials, students will develop a solid foundation in medical English terminology to support their future academic and clinical training.

教学目标

  1. 掌握医学英语术语的历史来源、发展及语言基础。
  2. 理解医学术语的构词规律，包括词根、前缀、后缀及其组合方式。
  3. 熟悉人体各系统（含解剖、生理、病理、检查、治疗、药理）相关的英文常用术语。
  4. 能够阅读和理解医学英文病例、检查报告及基础医学文献中的术语。
  5. 能够在口头与书面表达中准确、规范地使用医学英语术语。
  6. 提升跨课程学习能力，为医学课程、科研写作和临床实践奠定语言基础。

教学方式

• 课堂讲授：介绍术语体系、构词法及系统专业术语。
• 术语分析与构词练习：巩固核心术语结构与语义。
• 阅读与英文报告解析：提升术语在真实语境中的理解能力。
• 课堂讨论与小组合作：专题分析各系统临床材料。
• 医学文献阅读：通过原版材料强化术语应用能力。
• 在线资源与作业：利用数字化工具进行术语复习、测验和延伸学习。

教学内容与进度安排

  • Week 1 Course Introduction
    Teaching objectives:

    • Understand course goals, structure, assessment methods, and learning expectations.

    Week 2 The Etymology of Medical Terminology
    Teaching objectives:

    • Understand Greek and Latin origins of medical terms.
    • Recognize how etymology supports understanding medical vocabulary.

    Week 3 Characteristics of Medical Terminology
    Teaching objectives:

    • Identify accuracy, conciseness, and standardization in medical terminology.

    Week 4 Word‑Formation Processes  
    Teaching objectives:

    • Understand common ways of forming medical terms in English.

    Week 5 Word Roots and Combining Forms

    Teaching objectives:

    • Understand how word roots and combining forms create medical terms.

    Week 6 Prefixes
    Teaching objectives:

    • Learn common medical prefixes and how they shape meaning.

    Week 7 Suffixes
    Teaching objectives:

    • Learn diagnostic, procedural, and descriptive suffixes.

    Week 8 Structure of the Human Body
    Teaching objectives:

    • Understand levels of anatomical organization (cells–tissues–organs–systems).

    Week 9 Mid‑term Test
    Assessment: Covers Weeks 1–8.

    Week 10 The Integumentary System
    Teaching objectives:

    • Learn key medical terminology related to the skin, hair, and nails.

    Week 11 The Skeletal System
    Teaching objectives:

    • Learn terminology for bones, joints, and skeletal functions.

    Week 12 The Muscular System
    Teaching objectives:

    • Understand muscle types and common terminology.

    Week 13 The Cardiovascular System
    Teaching objectives:

    • Learn terminology related to the heart, blood vessels, and circulation.

    Week 14 The Respiratory System
    Teaching objectives:

    • Understand major terms related to respiration and lung structures.

    Week 15 Student Presentation
    Teaching objectives:

    • Apply medical terminology in explaining systems, diseases, or processes.

    Week 16 Q & A / Review
    Teaching objectives:

    • Review and consolidate all key terminology.
